#!/usr/bin/env python3

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/src')

from aeread_families.procurement_allocation.risk_gate_campaign import (
    V3_CAMPAIGN_ID, 
    CAMPAIGN_ID, 
    MAX_ACTION_ATTEMPTS,
    build_plan
)

print("=== Verification of v4 Campaign Changes ===")
print(f"V3_CAMPAIGN_ID: {V3_CAMPAIGN_ID}")
print(f"CAMPAIGN_ID: {CAMPAIGN_ID}")
print(f"MAX_ACTION_ATTEMPTS: {MAX_ACTION_ATTEMPTS}")

# Check the plan lineage
plan = build_plan()
lineage = plan["lineage"]

print("\n=== Lineage Verification ===")
print(f"Supersedes: {lineage['supersedes_campaign_id']}")
print(f"V3 disposition: {lineage.get('v3_disposition', 'MISSING')}")
print(f"Scientific contract: {lineage['scientific_contract']}")
print(f"Operational changes: {lineage['operational_changes_only']}")

# Verify key requirements
assert V3_CAMPAIGN_ID == "procurement_allocation_glm53_flash_parasail_risk_gate_factorial_v3"
assert CAMPAIGN_ID == "procurement_allocation_glm53_flash_parasail_risk_gate_factorial_v4"
assert MAX_ACTION_ATTEMPTS == 4
assert lineage["supersedes_campaign_id"] == V3_CAMPAIGN_ID
assert "three_consecutive_rate_limits" in lineage["v3_disposition"]
assert lineage["scientific_contract"] == "unchanged_from_v1_v2_and_v3"
assert lineage["operational_changes_only"] == ["increase maximum action attempts per logical action from 3 to 4"]

print("\n✅ All verification checks passed!")
